department: School of Data Science (PhD in Data Science)

deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications are due January 8, 2027 (11:59 pm ET), with a one-week grace period for transcripts, English scores and letters.
deadline.quote: The following deadlines are for Fall 2027 admission: | Friday, Jan. 8, 2027 (11:59 pm ET)

gre_general.quote: The Ph.D. in Data Science does not review other standardized test scores (i.e., GRE, GMAT, MCAT) in its holistic evaluation of applicants.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores of any kind are not reviewed.
gre_subject.quote: The Ph.D. in Data Science does not review other standardized test scores (i.e., GRE, GMAT, MCAT) in its holistic evaluation of applicants.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall (22/22/23/23 sections) for tests before 21 Jan 2026; 5 overall on the new scale after that. Higher than the Graduate School's 90.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL taken prior to Jan. 21, 2026: 100 overall (including minimum section scores of 22 in speaking, 22 in writing, 23 in reading, and 23 in listening).

also.quote: TOEFL taken after Jan. 21, 2026: 5 overall (including minimum section scores of 4 in speaking, 4.5 in writing, 4.5 in reading, and 5 in listening).

supervisor.value: You do not need a supervisor before applying; students usually choose one by the end of year two.
supervisor.quote: The Ph.D. in Data Science program does not require students to identify a research supervisor prior to applying for our program.

funding.value: Admitted students get School of Data Science support for the duration of their enrollment: tuition and fee remission, health premium and annual wages.
funding.quote: Admitted applicants will receive financial support from the School of Data Science for the duration of their enrollment in the program

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is enough; a master's is not required and does not improve your chances.
entry_route.quote: does not make an applicant more competitive in the admissions process | We welcome applicants from all undergraduate majors or programs of study who have earned their bachelor's degree

notes: Own application and English rules from the School of Data Science. IELTS 7.0 overall matches the Graduate School; fee is $85.
